dialogues.speaker: Furious Samurai
dialogues.text: Don't struggle if you don't wanna bleed — leave your Mora and walk away.

dialogues.speaker: Peco
dialogues.text: Help! Someone save me!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa, we should go help that guy!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! Big guy! What do you think you're doing? Stop it right now!

dialogues.speaker: Furious Samurai
dialogues.text: Mora... No, no! It was you who killed Murasaki... You must die!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Whoa! Watch out, {NICKNAME}!

dialogues.speaker: Peco
dialogues.text: Thank you both so much for saving me! I'm Peco, a traveling merchant. If you ever run into me in the future, I'll make sure to give you the best deals around!

dialogues.speaker: Peco
dialogues.text: Today's my unlucky day... What did I do to deserve to run into this "legend"?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: "Legend"? Is that guy famous or something?

dialogues.speaker: Peco
dialogues.text: Not in a good way. Word gets around among us traders... A few colleagues said they ran into him and swore they'd never take this route again. I didn't believe them, figured they were exaggerating...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You're braver than you look.

dialogues.speaker: Peco
dialogues.text: We traveling merchants see all kinds of things, you know? And, well, sometimes stories grow in the telling...

dialogues.speaker: Peco
dialogues.text: But anyway — they call him "Gonpachi." Rumor has it he got into trouble back in Inazuma and fled out here with his lover in tow.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: So that "Murasaki" he kept mumbling about was...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: #Oh, right! That weirdo kept mumbling that name during the fight with {NICKNAME}.

dialogues.speaker: Peco
dialogues.text: Once you stray from the straight and narrow, it's hard to get back on track — even in a new place. Without honest work, you end up back where you started.

dialogues.speaker: Peco
dialogues.text: This lifestyle might work for a lone wolf. But living life by the sword... Sooner or later, you're bound to cross the wrong person.

dialogues.speaker: Peco
dialogues.text: From what I heard, that's how his lover met her end. Ever since then, he's been... well, not quite right in the head.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: *sigh* Robbing people is awful, but... knowing how he ended up like this makes Paimon feel kinda bad for him...

choices.text: Let's hope Paimon doesn't turn to a life of crime...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: HEY! That's not the point of this story!

response.speaker: Peco
response.text: Alright, I won't keep you two any longer. Please, take this as a token of my gratitude.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Hehe, it's a good thing I've got you around! {NICKNAME}, my Mora guardian!

dialogues.speaker: Furious Samurai
dialogues.text: Murasaki... Murasaki...
